# Is Dependabot actually watching all of your repo?

> Paste your dependabot.yml and your repo's file list. Finds ecosystems Dependabot never updates, invalid intervals, duplicate entries, missing groups and cooldown, and writes a starter config. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
